2607.28545.title: ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?
2607.28545.paper_summary: Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something different: reasoning over noisy metrics, logs, traces, and source code, starting from ambiguous user-facing reports, often hours after the incident began. We introduce ORCA-bench, a benchmark that puts general-purpose coding agents in a production-fidelity oncall setting. ORCA-bench pairs a live OpenTelemetry-instrumented microservice system--exposing six days of metrics, logs, and traces through real telemetry interfaces (Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana) and full source-code access--with 1,079 RCA tasks that systematically vary report specificity, time-to-detection, and co-occurring fault scenarios. Ground-truth symptoms are curated and signed off by expert SREs, and our LLM-as-judge is independently re-scored by humans (Cohen's $κ_w=0.90$). Across five frontier agents, the best RCA Accuracy is 25.3% on Medium-difficulty tasks (the realistic-input setting) and 10.0% on Hard--a gap that remains even with Claude Fable 5. The weakest model hallucinates an implausible root cause in 40% of incident reports, and removing source-code access degrades every metric. Crucially, these are performances on a curated 50 GB / six-day testbed with tasks investigated in isolation on a system whose code and instrumentation are public. Since real production systems are order of magnitudes larger, more dynamic, and more idiosyncratic, the gap we report is a lower bound on the engineering investment required before frontier coding agents can be safely entrusted with production reliability. We release the public set at https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/ORCA-bench.
2607.28545.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以撰寫、修補和搜尋代碼，但值班根本原因分析（RCA）需要不同的東西：對嘈雜的指標、日誌、追蹤和源代碼進行推理，從模糊的用戶報告開始，通常是在事件開始幾小時後。我們介紹了 ORCA-bench，一個將通用編碼代理置於生產保真度的值班環境中的基準。ORCA-bench 將一個實時的 OpenTelemetry 標記的微服務系統與 1,079 個 RCA 任務配對，該系統提供六天的指標、日誌和追蹤，通過真實的遙測介面（Prometheus、Jaeger 和通過 Grafana 的 OpenSearch）以及完整的源代碼訪問，並系統性地變化報告的具體性、檢測時間和共存故障場景。真實症狀由專家 SRE 精心策劃並簽署，我們的 LLM 作為評判者由人類獨立重新評分（Cohen 的 $κ_w=0.90$）。在五個前沿代理中，最佳 RCA 準確率在中等難度任務（現實輸入設置）上為 25.3%，在困難任務上為 10.0%——這一差距即使在 Claude Fable 5 中仍然存在。最弱的模型在 40% 的事件報告中幻想出不合情理的根本原因，而移除源代碼訪問會降低每個指標。關鍵是，這些是在一個策劃的 50 GB / 六天測試平台上的表現，任務在一個代碼和儀器是公開的系統中孤立調查。由於真實的生產系統大數量級更大、更動態且更具特異性，我們報告的差距是前沿編碼代理在可以安全地信任生產可靠性之前所需的工程投資的下限。我們在 https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/ORCA-bench 發布了公共集。
